privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introduction: At VClaw, we believe that privacy is the foundation of business trust. This policy outlines our comprehensive approach to handling your data with maximum transparency and security, especially within our local-first architecture.

collection.title: 1. Data Collection
collection.content: We minimize data collection to what is strictly necessary. Most of your operational data is stored directly on your device. We only process:
items: Local Identity Information: Workspace name and preferences stored in your browser.
Operational Data: Orders, customers, and appointments reside entirely in your local storage (IndexedDB/SQLite).
Third-party Integrations: If you use VietQR or Zalo, minimal data is sent to these providers to perform catch tasks (e.g., generating a QR code).

usage.title: 2. How We Use Data
usage.content: Your data belongs to you. We do not collect your operational data to train internal models or for behavioral analysis. Data is strictly used to:
items: Provide real-time operational dashboards on your machine.
Generate business workflows and reminders for operators.
Improve user experience via anonymous telemetry (if opted-in).

sharing.title: 3. Data Sharing
sharing.content: We do not sell your data. We share data only when you actively trigger connectivity actions (e.g., sending a bill via chat or a payment request).

security.title: 4. Security Measures
security.content: As a local-first system, security resides at two layers:
items: Device Layer: Data is protected by your operating system and browser's built-in security.
Application Layer: Encryption of sensitive data and use of secure protocols (TLS 1.3) for integration adapters.

rights.title: 5. Your Rights
rights.content: You have full control over your data. You can delete all application data by clearing your browser cache or using the 'Delete Data' feature within VClaw settings.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.introduction: Welcome to VClaw. These Terms of Service ('Terms') constitute a legally binding agreement between you and VClaw regarding your use of our operational tools and the OpenClaw substrate.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing the admin shell or using our features, you confirm that you have the authority and agree to these terms. If you do not agree, you must not access the Service.

license.title: 2. License & Usage Limits
license.content: VClaw grants you a limited, non-exclusive license to:
items: Use the VClaw platform for internal business operations management.
Integrate OpenClaw workflows into your sales processes.
Restrictions: You may not reverse engineer the system core or use the service for illegal purposes.

liability.title: 3. Limitation of Liability
liability.content: VClaw is provided 'as is'. To the maximum extent permitted by law, we shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or special damages, including local data loss due to hardware or software failures on the user side.

termination.title: 4. Termination
termination.content: We may suspend or terminate your access immediately if you violate these Terms, particularly regarding malicious use of connectivity infrastructure. You may terminate your use at any time by removing the application.

governing.title: 5. Governing Law
governing.content: These Terms shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Socialist Republic of Vietnam.
